LESSON: LANGUAGE GROUPS IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: PEOPLE, POPULATION AND SOCIAL ORGANISATIONS
Topic 2.1: Language groups in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Language groups in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do people migrate?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the classification of communities in Eastern Africa according to language groups
2. explain the reasons for migration of selected language groups into Eastern Africa
3. describe the effects of the migration and settlement of selected language groups in Eastern Africa
4. appreciate unity of language groups in Eastern Africa

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: LANGUAGE GROUPS IN EASTERN AFRICA
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Language groups in Eastern Africa helps you succeed in SOCIAL STUDIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

KEY FACTS: LANGUAGE GROUPS IN EASTERN AFRICA
Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.
Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.
Rights come with responsibilities.

PART 1: Describe the classification of communities in Eastern Africa according to language groups

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the classification of communities in Eastern Africa according to language groups. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the classification of communities in Eastern Africa according to language groups.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Locate: Connect “Language groups in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home).

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the classification of communities in Eastern Africa according to language groups. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain the reasons for migration of selected language groups into Eastern Africa

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the reasons for migration of selected language groups into Eastern Africa. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the reasons for migration of selected language groups into Eastern Africa.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Give one cause and one effect linked to Language groups in Eastern Africa.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the reasons for migration of selected language groups into Eastern Africa. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Describe the effects of the migration and settlement of selected language groups in Eastern Africa

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the effects of the migration and settlement of selected language groups in Eastern Africa. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the effects of the migration and settlement of selected language groups in Eastern Africa.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Participate: Describe one responsible action a Grade learner can take.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the effects of the migration and settlement of selected language groups in Eastern Africa. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Appreciate unity of language groups in Eastern Africa

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate unity of language groups in Eastern Africa. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate unity of language groups in Eastern Africa.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Locate: Connect “Language groups in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home).

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate unity of language groups in Eastern Africa. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Language groups in Eastern Africa is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.

Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.

Example 1: Connect “Language groups in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home). (skill: describe the classification of communities in Eastern Africa according to language groups)

Example 2: Give one cause and one effect linked to Language groups in Eastern Africa. (skill: explain the reasons for migration of selected language groups into Eastern Africa)

Example 3: Describe one responsible action a Grade learner can take. (skill: describe the effects of the migration and settlement of selected language groups in Eastern Africa)

Example 4: Connect “Language groups in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home). (skill: appreciate unity of language groups in Eastern Africa)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Language groups in Eastern Africa to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe the classification of communities in Eastern Africa according to language groups.
3. Practise this skill: explain the reasons for migration of selected language groups into Eastern Africa.
4. Practise this skill: describe the effects of the migration and settlement of selected language groups in Eastern Africa.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Language groups in Eastern Africa from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Language groups in Eastern Africa: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Language groups in Eastern Africa?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do people migrate?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Language groups in Eastern Africa means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe the classification of communities in Eastern Africa according to language groups.
5. Be able to: explain the reasons for migration of selected language groups into Eastern Africa.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
